text:
ravi: quick econ snapshot for ember-lite-8b bring-up (2.2k chat samples). short recs below.

anna: numbers pls

ravi: model stats:
ember-lite-8b-int6 -> p50 140ms, p95 330ms, avg toks 320, cost/1M $12.80, GTN multi-turn 0.84
ember-lite-8b-int4 -> p50 175ms, p95 520ms, avg toks 320, cost/1M $6.70, GTN multi-turn 0.79

kevin: ~48% cost cut, ~0.05 GTN drop. where does quality fall apart?

ravi: mostly on multi-turn chains with branching clarifications and few-shot persona prompts. single-turn Qs fine. hallucination roughly stable.

anna: recommendation for routing?

ravi: suggest default -> int4; pin to int6 when context_tokens > 600 OR user_tier == enterprise OR GTN flags high_criticality. Canary 5% -> 25% over 10d, nightly GTN diffs, 48h shadow on top flows. Rollback flag in place.

kevin: expected unit-econ after routing?

ravi: simple mix 70% int4 + 30% int6 => ~$8.86 / 1M (≈31% savings). If 20% pinned to int6 => ~$9.76 / 1M (≈24% savings).

ops-bot: canary flag created: `ember-lite-mixed-canary` at 1799991111.

anna: GTM line for deck?

ravi: "Ember-lite-8b int4 halves per-token cost with small quality tradeoffs; recommend mixed-fleet routing to capture ~24-31% unit-cost savings while keeping enterprise/long-context traffic on int6."

kevin: add per-slice CSV + 50 sample failures to the onboarding folder.

ravi: will upload by EOD."
